title: Manyhands JSON v1 blocked request
description: The data of a busy or recovery_required answer of a mutation that was refused because another operation's row is unfinished: that operation, in place of the command's own data. A prepare refused so, as an operation abandon of a synchronization another process still works under is, carries it in place of a preview. Its recovery offers operation.show for it. A busy answer of this shape waited for the operation's holder for a bounded time first; the same request may be sent again. A lifecycle answer keeps its own data, the list of what stands in its way.
